mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year indicates inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently higher interest rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 5% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates growing demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the cases over a 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a strengthening economy, which can lead to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is below 2% year-over-year, it indicates a potential monetary policy misalignment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the trigger condition is met and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) suggests strong labor market conditions, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the trigger condition is met and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS decreases and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the cases over a 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) indicates a slowing economy, which can lead to lower corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 decreases and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases over a 2-year rolling window.
